title: Keep Evaluation Fair: Detecting Data Leakage in Code Generation Benchmarks via Membership Inference Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2609.09865v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code generation benchmarks are widely used to evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs), but benchmark data leakage into training sets can inflate performance and undermine evaluation validity. DetectLeak, a method specifically designed for code generation benchmark leakage detection, relies on perplexity scores to identify likely leaked samples. However, perplexity mainly reflects general familiarity with code patterns and may perform poorly on complex or rare samples. It also overlooks other useful signals, such as code similarity, functional correctness, and semantic representations. To address these limitations, we propose CGMIA (Code-Generation-specific Membership Inference Attack), a method for detecting leakage in code generation benchmarks. CGMIA fine-tunes a shadow model on a subset of benchmark samples to construct labeled member and non-member data. For each sample, it collects the input prompt, generated code, and reference solut

translated_title: 保持评估公平：通过成员推理攻击检测代码生成基准中的数据泄露
translated_abstract: 代码生成基准被广泛用于评估大型语言模型（LLM），但基准数据泄露到训练集中可能会虚高性能并损害评估的有效性。DetectLeak是一种专门为代码生成基准泄露检测而设计的方法，它依赖困惑度分数来识别可能泄露的样本。然而，困惑度主要反映对代码模式的一般熟悉程度，在复杂或罕见样本上可能表现不佳，同时它还忽略了其他有用的信号，例如代码相似性、功能正确性和语义表示。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了CGMIA（针对代码生成的成员推理攻击），这是一种用于检测代码生成基准中数据泄露的方法。CGMIA在基准样本的子集上微调一个影子模型，以构建带有标签的成员和非成员数据。对于每个样本，它收集输入提示、生成的代码和参考解决方案等信号来进行泄露判定。
tldr: 提出CGMIA方法，通过在影子模型上执行成员推理攻击，并综合输入提示、生成代码、功能正确性和语义表示等多维信号，克服了基于困惑度的DetectLeak方法的局限，有效检测代码生成基准中的数据泄露问题。
en_tdlr: We propose CGMIA, a code-generation-specific membership inference attack method that detects data leakage in code generation benchmarks by leveraging multi-dimensional signals such as generated code and semantic representations, overcoming the limitations of perplexity-based detection approaches like DetectLeak.
